title: feat(nscosx): same-tick x lock sum: reverse fail, face holds
science: Same-tick-inclusive lock sum on the x-probes: L(A)=(5,0,0), L(B)=(2,0,1), L(C)=-e_2, L(D)=+e_2 -> reverse FAIL (sum (7,0,1)), face HOLD.
